title: Steps to create term deposit monthly interest

steps.text: Login to mobile application,Land on deposits dashboard
Select Term Deposit Monthly Interest” type , Click Select
Select 'Use the same account as funding' if needed, Click Next
Enter required deposit amount , Note: Minimum deposit amount is 5000 JOD
Select period-interest return and   Select auto renew upon maturity if needed If selected, then “renew principal amount only” is displayed as the only option , then click 'Next'
Review deposit details , Confirm the “Terms and Conditions”  then Click 'Confirm'
